title: validate_set_emphasis/apply_set_emphasis proc names keep the retired coinage while binding Cmd_Set_Weights
evidence:
core/topology.odin:395 "validate_set_emphasis :: proc(t: ^Topology, c: Cmd_Set_Weights, cat: ^Catalogs) -> Edit_Error {"
core/topology.odin:417 "apply_set_emphasis :: proc(t: ^Topology, c: Cmd_Set_Weights, cat: ^Catalogs) {"
core/topology.odin:483-484 "case Cmd_Set_Weights:" / "if e := validate_set_emphasis(t, c, cat); e != .None { return {}, e }" / "apply_set_emphasis(t, c, cat)"
Audit scope column (terminology-audit-v1.md): "| **Cmd_Set_Emphasis** → **Cmd_Set_Weights** | ... "Emphasis" is the retired 3.2 dial's word ... | ✅ RENAME (minor) | one union variant + comments | none (tag constant kept) |"
detail: The audit's scope column for the Cmd_Set_Emphasis row covers only 'one union variant + comments'; the validate/apply proc identifiers still carry the retired word 'emphasis' and are not recorded as kept. Undocumented exception in the command's core path.
recommended_fix: Rename to validate_set_weights/apply_set_weights (including the doc comments), or record the kept names in the audit scope column.
